title: Bi-modal MvG derivative-consistent retention representation
question: Does the F-AHL derivative-consistent z=logit(Se), x=log10(-h) cubic-Hermite representation generalize to the source-authoritative bi-modal MvG retention/capacity family without independent C approximation?
near_saturation_policy: h > -1 cm remains authoritative analytical and is not interpolated
source_binding_rule: The research sampler must fail closed unless the exact corrected source SHA matches and the model-3 theta/C source expressions are present. The formulas are transcribed from that pinned source, not from textbook convention.
decision_rule: PASS only if all three preregistered parameterizations meet both constitutive gates on independent dense validation points and the represented C is obtained solely by differentiating the same interpolant used for theta.
